## Ethics floor (binding — not researched away)

No fake scarcity. No fabricated social proof. Symmetric choices (declining as easy as
accepting). No confirm-shaming. { plus any domain-specific legal obligations found in research —
e.g. DSA Art. 25 / FTC dark-pattern exposure for this market }. Litmus: a technique that only
works when the user doesn't notice it is a dark pattern — excluded regardless of evidence tier.
